symptom: Nightly `mx check` reports `CE0117 "Error(s) in expression." at Log message activity 'Log message (warning)'` on Mendix 10.24.19+ but not 10.24.16 or 11.x
cause: Mendix 10.24.19 tightened expression validation: `toString(<string>)` is now a type error (toString expects a non-string input). An example called `toString($OrderNumber)` where `$OrderNumber` was already a string parameter
file: The offending `log warning ... with ({1} = toString($stringVar))` — find via `~/.mxcli/mxbuild/{ver}/modeler/mx check`, then bisect with `drop microflow ...` until CE0117 disappears
insight: Remove the redundant `toString()` wrapper around already-string values. Only wrap non-string values (integers, decimals, dates, enums) in `toString()`. The Mendix 11.x parser is more lenient and lets this slide, but 10.24.19+ rejects it
